notes: The marginal 'children' reading is not the one the projection carries; ἔργων is aligned to the printed 'works'.
ἄνθρωπος φάγος → 'a gluttonous man': the noun takes the discontinuous 'a … man' and φάγος the attributive 'gluttonous'.
τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς leaves its article unrepresented under rule 20, αὐτῆς being free to take 'her'.
